title: Sylbobek's Shader Pack
description: Realistic, FPS-friendly shaders - soft shadows, procedural sky, waving plants, glowing lights and cinematic colors.
body:
# Sylbobek's Shader Pack

**A realistic, performance-friendly shader pack that turns Minecraft into a living, breathing world - soft shadows, a fully procedural sky, animated vegetation and stylish cinematic colors, all running smoothly even on mid-range PCs.**

Sylbobek's Shader Pack is a complete lighting overhaul written from scratch in GLSL. It replaces Minecraft's flat vanilla lighting with a modern deferred rendering pipeline: real-time shadow mapping, HDR lighting with ACES tonemapping, atmospheric fog and full post-processing - while staying light enough to keep high FPS.

---

## ☀️ Sky & Atmosphere

- **Fully procedural sky** - no static skybox textures. The sky color, sun and clouds are computed in real time.
- **Golden sunrises and sunsets** - the horizon glows orange, sunlight turns warm and shadows stretch with the sun angle.
- **Dynamic clouds** - procedural cloud layer that drifts with time and thickens when a storm is coming. During rain the whole sky turns overcast and gray.
- **Night sky** - twinkling stars and a moon with **real moon phases** synced to the in-game calendar.
- **God rays (volumetric light shafts)** - sunlight visibly breaks through tree leaves and cave openings; moonlight does the same at night.
- **Atmospheric fog** - distance fog tinted by the sky color, denser during rain and at night. The Nether gets its own warm, reddish fog.

## 🌑 Lighting & Shadows

- **Real-time soft shadows** - every block and entity casts a dynamic shadow with smooth, natural edges (PCF filtering on a Vogel disk, 4096px shadow map).
- **Colored shadows** - light passing through stained glass or water tints the shadow with its color.
- **Warm torchlight** - torches, lanterns and glowstone cast a cozy, warm-orange light with realistic falloff, clearly distinct from cool skylight.
- **Emissive blocks glow** - lava, glowstone, sea lanterns, froglights, campfires and more actually emit a visible glow (bloom).
- **Hemispheric ambient light** - surfaces facing the sky are brighter than ceilings and undersides, giving the world real depth instead of flat vanilla shading.

## 🌊 Water

- **Animated procedural waves** - the water surface constantly moves with layered wave noise.
- **Sky reflections with Fresnel** - water mirrors the sky at grazing angles and turns transparent when you look straight down, just like real water.
- **Sun glitter** - a bright specular streak dances on the waves at sunset.
- **Underwater atmosphere** - dense blue fog and light shafts when you dive.

## 🌿 Living Vegetation

Almost every plant in the game is animated with its own motion style:

| Plant | Motion |
|---|---|
| Grass, flowers, crops | quick swaying in the wind (stronger during rain) |
| Tree leaves | gentle 3D rustling |
| Bamboo & sugar cane | whole stalks bend with a wave traveling up the stem |
| Vines on walls | slide along the wall surface and flutter outward |
| Kelp & seagrass | slow, wide swaying in underwater currents |

## 🎬 Post-processing

- **ACES filmic tonemapping** - the same color response curve used in the movie industry; highlights roll off softly instead of clipping to white.
- **3 built-in color profiles** - *Realistic* (muted, natural), *Vivid* (default, punchy colors) and *Cinematic* (teal & orange movie grade).
- **Bloom** - bright light sources bleed a soft glow into the scene.
- **Subtle FXAA** - smooths jagged edges without blurring block textures (can be toggled off).
- **Vignette and adjustable contrast/saturation/exposure.**

## ⚡ Performance

Designed to be FPS-friendly from the ground up:

- **Adaptive shadow sampling** - full 16-tap soft shadows are computed only at shadow edges; the rest of the screen uses a fast 5-tap path (~3× cheaper).
- Lightweight procedural sky instead of expensive volumetrics.
- Every heavy effect (shadows resolution, god rays, bloom, FXAA) can be tuned or disabled in **Shader Options** - the pack scales from potato to beast PC.

## 📥 Installation

1. Install **OptiFine** *or* **Iris + Sodium** (recommended for 1.21.x).
2. Download the ZIP and drop it into `.minecraft/shaderpacks/`.
3. In game: **Options → Video Settings → Shaders** → select *Sylbobek's Shader Pack*.
4. Tweak everything to your taste in **Shader Options** (sliders for exposure, saturation, fog, bloom, shadow softness, water waves and more).

**Supported:** Minecraft 1.21.x • OptiFine HD U J9+ • Iris 1.7+
**Not required:** no resource pack needed, works with vanilla textures.

## 🗺️ Roadmap

**Coming in v2.0:**

- Real-time **screen-space reflections** on water (terrain, buildings and torches mirrored in real time)
- **Depth-based water clarity** with refraction and animated **caustics**
- **Wet ground** that darkens and glistens after rain
- **Held-item light** (walk through caves with a torch in hand)
- **Eye adaptation** when moving between caves and daylight
- **Shooting stars** on clear nights

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: My FPS dropped, what should I lower first?**
A: Set `shadowMapResolution` to 2048 (or 1024) in Shader Options - shadows are the heaviest effect.

**Q: Does it work with the Nether and the End?**
A: Yes. Both dimensions use simplified lighting with dimension-tinted fog; a full custom sky for them is planned.

**Q: The image is too soft/blurry for me.**
A: Turn off FXAA in Shader Options - the pack is fully playable without it.

**Q: Iris or OptiFine?**
A: Both work. On 1.21.x we recommend **Iris + Sodium** for noticeably better performance.

---

*Made with ❤️ by Sylbobek. Feedback and screenshots welcome in the comments!*
